reader.requirement: At --std 85, for every category written in INITIALIZE REPLACING (only the five 1985 categories ALPHABETIC, ALPHANUMERIC, NUMERIC, ALPHANUMERIC-EDITED, NUMERIC-EDITED), a MOVE of identifier-2 or literal-1 to an elementary item of that category must be legal by §1985:VI.6.19.4 GR3: SPACE, an alphabetic or alphanumeric-edited sender never to NUMERIC/NUMERIC-EDITED; a numeric literal, ZERO, a numeric or numeric-edited sender never to ALPHABETIC; a noninteger numeric literal or item never to ALPHANUMERIC/ALPHANUMERIC-EDITED; numeric-edited to numeric is legal at level 2 (INITIALIZE is level 2); HIGH-VALUE, LOW-VALUE, QUOTE and ALL literals are category alphanumeric and so legal to NUMERIC; a reference-modified sender keeps alphabetic but turns numeric, numeric-edited and alphanumeric-edited into alphanumeric (§1985:IV.4.3.8.4.4 GR5).

edition-consulted.switches: FigurativeAssociation.GateSr5 per NUMERIC/NUMERIC-EDITED category for a HIGH-VALUE/LOW-VALUE/QUOTE/ALL-literal sender: permitted at 85, COBOL0902 (QUOTE) or COBOL0903 (digit-only ALL literal) at 2023
ConstructRegistry rows initialize-category-2002/2014/2023: the post-1985 category-names (NATIONAL, BOOLEAN, pointers, ...) are COBOL0900 at 85; the five 1985 names are ungated

reader.edition-search: MoveTable16.Validity / MoveValidity.Table16Refusal / FigurativeRefusal take no edition (the table is documented as version-invariant and its 85-relevant cells match §1985:VI.6.19.4 GR3 a-c, with d's level-1 prohibition not applying at level 2); grepped MoveTable16.cs and MoveValidity.cs for Edition|Year|CobolVersion: none. The edition reads are in the post-bind VersionConformancePass.
